table.name: TLGNC_LOG
table.description: Logtable used by PL/SQL code running on the database directly, i.e. which cannot write into the normal logfile of the application. A periodic cleanup job deletes old entries. Different severities have different lifetime. Errors in this logtable could periodically be checked, and copied into the application log, or sent by e-mail to an operator (in a future release of Logon).

column.name: LOG_ID
column.description: PK. Unique ID of the log entry.

column.name: LOG_SEVERITY
column.description: Severity of the logged event. One of INFO, DEBUG, ERROR

column.name: LOG_SOURCE
column.description: Package and name of the procedure who logged the event.

column.name: LOG_SQLCODE
column.description: Error code retrieved from the exception thrown, if any.

column.name: LOG_SQLERRM
column.description: Error message retrieved from the exception thrown, if any.

column.name: LOG_TEXT
column.description: Any text describing the logged event.

column.name: RUN_NUMBER
column.description: Used to mark log messages or imported records as belonging together. Entries with the same run_number, generated by the same background job (log_source) belong together.
